scope: Assigned 211 dark local pairs from recheck-dark-2.tsv; existing screenshots only.

review_method.primary_crop: Pixel-difference bounding box with context, clipped to source bounds.
review_method.downscale_rule: Only crops wider than 780 pixels are reduced to 780 pixels per side.
review_method.layout: Main left, candidate right; at most two labeled pairs per image.

limitations: This review covers only the assigned dark local screenshot pairs; it does not rerun suites or establish interaction success from loading or failed-selector frames.
Pairs classified as traversal noise need matched settled states if the integrator requires a behavioral conclusion.
The assigned list does not include neighborhood captures at 1280 or 1440.

pairs.reason: The selected-path lists contain different entities; main has an empty canvas while candidate has a grid. This is not a matching selected state.
